rust_summary: a mod hurting a mob or a player as `LivingEntity.hurtServer` with a mob attack does (`native_hurt_entity`).
doc_summary: `native_hurt_entity(dimension, target, amount, damage_type, attacker)` hurts a mob or a player of the level as `LivingEntity.hurtServer` and `/damage ... by <attacker>` do (armour, effects, invulnerability time, knockback, death; the damage hooks hear it), the attacker as the causing and direct entity like `damageSources().mobAttack`; whether it was hurt. Bundles need "hooks": @API:hurt_entity@.
